name: TRACE: Tensor Residual Accumulation and Continuation/Exhaustion

mechanism.economic_hypothesis: Persistent participation pressure preceding repricing may imply delayed supply clearance; break-then-pressure may imply chasing. Renewal after stalled progress may distinguish continued sponsorship from exhaustion.
mechanism.observable_boundary: Close-location volume is a disclosed pressure proxy, not observed buyer intent or aggressor-signed order flow.
mechanism.specific_prediction: Conditional on endpoints, Tensor/momentum state, extension and costs, pressure-before-acceptance has lower first-passage failure than CHASE; negative pressure renewal after a price stall has lower remaining hold value.

horizon.entry_decision: daily at16:10 America/New_York after provider daily finality
horizon.hourly_clock: 09:30–10:30 through14:30–15:30 plus15:30–16:00; explicit half-hour last slot

features.factor_residual: r_i - a*d_j - b_SPY*r_SPY - b_sector*r_sector; hourly regression on slots from prior60sessions excluding path window; d_j=slotminutes/390; daily d_j=1 and weekly d_j=1 in week units
features.price_channel: cumulative factor residual divided by pre-window stdev(e/sqrt(d_j))*sqrt(sum_window(d_j)); positive train-frozen floor
features.volume_normalization: prior20sessions same intraday slot; prior20bars at daily/weekly scale; denominator ends before path window
features.path_interpolation: aligned straight segments; no imposed intrabar flow-first staircases
features.clock: cumulative d_j/sum_window(d_j), dimensionless elapsed trading-time fraction
features.phase_contrast: recentered second-half area minus first-half area under same pre-window scales
features.orthogonalization: training-only ridge area prediction on B; residual/MAD_train with positive floor
features.corporate_actions: as-of split-adjusted prices/volume, causal total-return signal chain; raw executable barriers and separately accrued distributions
features.hourly_first_return: sessionopen to firstslotclose, excludes overnight jump; later slots use preceding slot close

signal.model: multinomial ridge logistic on B +8 features; CONTINUE/FAIL/EXPIRE
signal.target: first-fill price +3cutoffATR first vs first-fill price -1.5cutoffATR protective stop;20sessions expiry; final average cost used only for realized PnL
signal.calibration: one temperature fit on matured separate chronological calibration window; outputs scores until OOS probability calibration supported
signal.expected_net_value: sum(class_score * training class-conditional net payoff mean)
signal.uncertainty: one-sided90% lower bound from calendar-week block bootstrap; uncertainty of estimated mean, not guaranteed realized profit

causal_phase.box: previous20session high/low frozen before daily20bar window
causal_phase.pressure_established: first q>=1 while abs(p)<=0.5 and close inside frozen box
causal_phase.acceptance: two consecutive completed closes above frozen box high
causal_phase.entry_sequence: pressure event before acceptance, acceptance ended within3sessions, no intervening close below frozen box low

entry.limit: initial limit cutoff close+0.5cutoffATR; after first fill reset remaining buy limit<=first-fill price
entry.halt_gap_unfilled: cancel zero-fill attempt or unfilled balance; preserve actual filled shares
entry.partial_fill: cancel unfilled remainder at09:45; retain all filled shares even if partial notional below1000USD
entry.fill_price: first-fill price freezes barriers immediately; final actual average cost determines PnL without retroactive barrier changes
entry.episode_population: every broad eligible flat cutoff;>=20session spacing per symbol in historical discovery; no winner-only labels; no-fill attempts separately reported
entry.barrier_during_acquisition: cancel remaining buys and exit actual filled shares; idempotent order cleanup
entry.volume_clock: only cumulative minute volume actually observed by fill time; no final-minute future-volume allocation

exit.age_exit: after20sessions at next executable morning window
exit.renewal_failure: 3closes without new closing high AND negative hourly residual phase contrast AND negative sum pressure increments over same3sessions
exit.remaining_value_model: fixed ridge on prior mature episodes; original age, barrier distances, phase block, renewal flag; labels original fixed-barrier continuation rather than optimal retrospective exit
exit.value_exit: 90% lower bound incremental retain-versus-next-window-liquidation below0 at2successive daily cutoffs
exit.stop_target_ordering: minute/quote chronology; ambiguous same-OHLC-bar stop first; gaps actual attainable fill
exit.initial_protective_stop_reference: first-fill price; ATR known at preceding daily cutoff
exit.fixed_target_reference: first-fill price; ATR known at preceding daily cutoff

portfolio.cash: record actual broker cash yield; no substitute strategy

timeline.engine: v690 source42fc461ef0327a3a7394f0a7cc37fadcc88816b0 frozen recipe; historical retrospective backcast, immutable per-cutoff prefixes
timeline.fit_known_at: before outer calibration/test; matured labels only

novel_contribution.claim: Proposed endpoint/Tensor-conditional multiscale order premium with causal pressure-before-price-acceptance transition and entry/renewal-retention asymmetry.
